name: mirage
text: PinnWire and the Pinnacle host feed are off (the key is used up elsewhere) and already not in use. Pinnacle prices are still coming in from the other APIs, about 3,800 Pinnacle lines per scan (SharpAPI, SportsGameOdds and ParlayAPI, all on). The engine log line 'silent feeds: pinnacle' is only the refused host, so nothing is missing. I changed nothing. Also: v1.0.61 (the Run on GitHub master switch) is building now; I'll send the link when it's out.
